notes.title: Little Wolf progress report
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 

Thought it was time to make a post. Now, I am a solo developer working on this title, so it is taking longer than expected to make Little Wolf to release to you all to enjoy. Little Wolf is mainly a collection and exploration game. I am adding some fights into the game too which should be a good challenge to the player.

However I am working hard between my busy schedule to make this a fun game for everyone to enjoy, it just means it may take a bit longer than I originally planned to release this game. 

Currently I am working on the following;

- AI animals to populate the map. Setting up specific areas etc
- Adding things to each map/ area for the player to do as well as explore.
- Adding at least two more boss fights, so you guys will have to fight AGNAR (a familiar) at least 3 times 
   but in different maps.
- Testing out different lighting to see what looks the best and suits the map.
- SFX and VFX
- Music for areas. Ambient and event.
- Adding some random events that you may find around the maps.
- Working on portals to only activate when player completes a task.
- Polishing off the pick up/ drop function, it will only be usable on certain objects. 
- General optimisations so you guys can have a pleasant experience.
- Will be making another short trailer when I have more time to showcase a couple new features.

I hope you can be a bit patient while I make this game better than it would be if I released it now!

Thanks for sticking it through to the end, I will try to keep updates regular for anyone who is interested.

Regards Winged Lizard, Creed.

notes.title: Little Wolf update
notes.content:
[b]Hello Everyone![/b]

We have been working hard on Little Wolf and have ticked off many things on our 'to do list'.
There are several important things we must do still but the game progression is coming along nicely.

I have uploaded some new, up to date, screenshots as well as a sample of the physics in Little Wolf. 
The game is running smoother on our testers computers now which is a massive win for us as it took some digging to figure out what the cause was.

More detail will be going into the landscape, new scripts, a new area and some new in game secrets for you as Ulf to discover will be added in shortly.

Below here is the link to our facebook page, between steam and facebook there will be updates and information of Little Wolf.

https://www.facebook.com/wingedlizard

Thankyou for reading,

Nate R

Winged Lizard, Little Wolf 2021
